evidence.finding: Every nonnull iterated binding performs segment lookup and EffectiveLifecycleV2Locked before tuple rejection; CatalogHistoryError and RecordingResourceUnavailable propagate as false/error. Results start cleared but catch does not promise clearing partially accumulated results.
SourceBindingPool is an in-memory unordered_map; SourceBindingEntry bool checks nonempty id. Iteration does not authenticate segment/state/retired bytes.
Retained find calls GetOwned and Decode; skipping find removes current raw authentication and possible read/admission/parse failures.
Lifecycle invokes RetiredLocked before state checks. Retired GetOwned/parse failure sets derived_job_state_authoritative_=false and throws. Workspace refusal throws RecordingResourceUnavailable.

CanReadLocked -> Healthy checks file identity/size and root node. Get traverses target nodes and Value validates target value hash separately. Root health is not authentication of every descendant/value.
